name: ZX-10 Combat Droid
description: The ZX-10 Combat Droid was an advanced model of battle droid developed by Czerka Corporation at their research moon CZ-198. Rasmus Blys had the line fitted with a tamper-proof security system that completely deactivated any sliced units, forcing the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire to destroy the ZX-10s still in their pods during the fighting at CZ-198.
